name: cGZDBWriteRecordPackedFile::GetFieldVoid
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 27, two stack arguments (out, size), ret 8. Record closed (subobject slot 5 GetAccessFlags zero): false. Sink set: returns sink slot 14 (out, size). Otherwise false when position + size (32-bit, wrapping) exceeds end - start (unsigned); else memcpy(out, start + position, size), position += size, true. Differential over 800 trials covering the closed record, sink, the exact-fit and one-over sizes, wrap-around positions that reach back into the buffer, and oversized arguments. Also checked through a routed slot 27. Mutants killed: bound >= instead of >; position advanced by 1; sink size off by one (xor 1); copy from start instead of start + position.

name: cGZDBWriteRecordPackedFile::vf56 (SeekRelative)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 56, one stack argument (signed offset), ret 4. Sums GetPosition() (this's slot 54) with the offset in 64 bits; negative fails; otherwise this's SeekAbsolute (slot 55) gets the low 32 bits. The test also checks with a fake slot 55 in the primary table that the call goes through the vtable (the original and ours hand the fake the same position). Edges: zero, sign boundaries, sums past 2^32 and offsets that land on zero. Mutants killed: negative test <= 0; position read from the field, not through slot 54; direct call to SeekAbsolute instead of the vtable (caught by the fake-slot check).

name: FUN_a09a70f0
notes: Constructor, owned. Sets the four owned vtables (rzface faces), the record flags byte to 3, empty buffer, position 0, no sink. Three-way difftest over key/type/mode inputs: the object bytes the original leaves equal ours, including the vtable pointers checked through the faces. Calls the temp-file maker 0x1c255e (ours since lane QN, MakeTempFile; the test stands it in on both sides). Mutants (filter on the test names): killed - size >= limit, record flags 2 instead of 3, free ignoring bit 4, resize +1, position left at 1, tried-file flag kept, sink-delete removed, the limit +1, a lower-case type in the temp name, offset += 1. Survivors, both equivalent: a copy chunk of kCopyChunk or size - done when the two are equal; small writes appended byte by byte or by resize+memcpy at n == the small-write limit (same bytes either way).
